project.name: Prunus Mume - Membership and Payment Result
project.instruction: Continue from the current project. Only implement membership purchase and payment-result experiences. Do not rewrite completed pages or introduce a new visual system.

references: Current project implementation after Stages 1 and 2
designContinuity: Continue the existing plum and deep-burgundy membership styling, white cards, thin borders, generous whitespace, and restrained Chinese education-product visual language.
Do not turn the membership page into an exaggerated marketing landing page.
Avoid artificial urgency, fake scarcity, excessive gradients, oversized illustrations, and unrelated promotional features.
objective: Complete a clear and trustworthy membership selection, mock order creation, and payment-result flow.

routes.name: Membership Upgrade
requirements: Explain membership value in a concise product-oriented introduction.
Provide a clear comparison of membership benefits.
Support MONTH, QUARTER, YEAR, and TRIAL duration options.
Visually emphasize a recommended option without using manipulative urgency.
Show an order summary with amount, CNY currency, Alipay payment method, and service notes.
The primary purchase action must support signed-out guidance, submitting, creation-failed, and creation-success states.
Use a mock order for this stage.
After mock creation succeeds, simulate leaving for payment and provide a demonstration path to the payment-result route.

routes.name: Payment Result
requirements: Support Success, Processing, and Failed result states.
Show order number, selected plan, amount, and appropriate next actions.
For Success, provide Start Practicing and Browse VIP Questions actions.
For Failed, provide Retry Payment and Return to Membership actions.

crossPageUpdates: Unify VIP badges and upgrade entry points across question detail, question-bank question lists, and the existing home-page VIP card.
Every VIP upgrade entry point must navigate to /membership.
Use the same terminology, badge appearance, and gating explanation throughout the application.
implementationConstraints: Use mock membership plans and mock orders in this stage.
Do not call Alipay or any real payment service yet.
Do not request a payment HTML page through fetch or XHR. The later real integration must use full-page browser navigation.
Do not add automatic renewal, coupons, refund management, or features outside the original specification.
Maintain keyboard accessibility, visible focus states, semantic markup, and appropriate ARIA labels.
Preserve and extend stable data-od-id attributes.
Support desktop, tablet, and approximately 390px mobile widths without horizontal scrolling.
Update affected tests to match the current application.
acceptanceCriteria: Changing the selected membership duration correctly updates the order summary.
Signed-out, submitting, failure, and success purchase states can all be demonstrated.
Success, Processing, and Failed payment results can all be demonstrated.
Every existing VIP entry point reaches the membership page.
Desktop and mobile layouts are complete.
The project passes TypeScript, lint, and build checks.
